title: Coffee order with defaults
hints: Give `size` and `shots` their default values right in the `def` line, like `size: str = "medium"`.
Build the text with an f-string. Pick the word first: `"shot"` when `shots == 1`, otherwise `"shots"`.
`def order_summary(drink: str, size: str = "medium", shots: int = 1) -> str:` then `word = "shot" if shots == 1 else "shots"` and `return f"{size} {drink}, {shots} {word}"`
